comment: Twelve frame glyphs submitted for owner approval. Built-in image generation supplied the four rough concept sheets. All final master coordinates were written by hand using the cited HST sources as visual references.

home.meaning: Open the home page of the File tab.
home.concept: Rough concept sheet, six separate small drawings on white, two rows of three. Flat outline icon, rounded strokes, 24 px grid, soft pastel fills. Draw these six meanings in reading order: a house marking the home page; a USB key with a check for setting up digital signatures; a folded sheet with a circular history arrow for past versions; a broken-outline sheet with a returning arrow for recovering an unsaved document; two offset sheets with an arrow turning over an edge for two-sided printing; a diskette with a small pencil for saving a new copy. Leave open space around each, no labels.
home.round_2: Extended the gable to both eaves. Cut the two 45-degree roof slopes into grid steps and set the blue door on integer fill edges.
home.round_3: Opened the sill around the blue door. The larger master draws both roof slopes in one continuous 45-degree stroke over the stepped gable. The native eaves still span all 16 pixels.
home.round_4: The blue door fills the opening down to the sill. Its 4 × 7 px blue interior at 16 px sits between the original posts. The wider door in the 24-unit master has integer fill edges.

tabclose.concept: Rough concept sheet for two small document tab controls. Flat outline icon, rounded strokes, 24 px grid, soft pastel fills reserved for other subjects. Two isolated outline-only marks on white: a light centered x to close a document tab, and a centered plus to open a new document tab. Give the two marks balanced visual weight and generous room. No button borders or labels.
tabclose.round_2: Extended the two pixel-stepped arms on opposing 45-degree axes. Reinforced their four inner steps so the crossing carries the same weight at fractional scales.
tabclose.round_3: The 24 px master draws a 45° × with a bold 2.4-unit pen and round caps. Its centre lines span 8 units and cross at (12, 12). The 16 px master forms the × from two 8-pixel staircases.
tabclose.round_4: The 16 px mark comes from the round-capped 2.4-unit master, preserving smooth diagonals at 200%. At 16 px it spans 8 × 8 px and uses 14.37% ink. A full 16 × 16 px trial used 32.16% ink with this pen or 16.78% with the thinnest snapped pen, above the 12.90% neighbour median. The thin trial also measured 0.636 fringe against a ceiling of 0.441. The 250% sharpness exception remains in effect.
tabclose.round_4c: The owner prioritised painted span and set the tab marks’ ink ceiling at the heaviest neighbouring LibreOffice close mark. Both diagonals now run between coordinates 4 and 20 on the 24-unit grid with a 2.4-unit pen, round caps and round joins. At 16 px the × spans 12 px with a measured stroke of 1.49 px, ink density of 0.233 and fringe of 0.375.

tabnew.concept: Rough concept sheet for two small document tab controls. Flat outline icon, rounded strokes, 24 px grid, soft pastel fills reserved for other subjects. Two isolated outline-only marks on white: a light centered x to close a document tab, and a centered plus to open a new document tab. Give the two marks balanced visual weight and generous room. No button borders or labels.
tabnew.round_2: Extended the straight arms across the tab control. Tuned the vertical stem around the crossing and the two crossbar ends to keep the plus legible at fractional scales.
tabnew.round_3: The 24 px master draws the + with the round-capped path M12 6V18M6 12H18 and a 1.65-unit pen. The 16 px master uses 1 px strokes that cross at (7.5, 7.5).
tabnew.round_4: The round-capped axes span 21 units on the 24-unit grid. At 16 px they extend from 0.5 to 15.5 and cross at (7.5, 7.5). The painted box is 16 × 16 px with 11.88% ink. Both axes meet at every display scale.
tabnew.round_4c: The 24-unit plus runs from 4 to 20 on each axis with a 1.65-unit pen. The native 16 px plus uses a 1 px pen from 1.5 to 13.5 on both axes, crossing at (7.5, 7.5). Its painted span is 13 px with zero fringe.

setupusbtoken.meaning: Set up a USB token for digital signatures.
setupusbtoken.concept: Rough concept sheet, six separate small drawings on white, two rows of three. Flat outline icon, rounded strokes, 24 px grid, soft pastel fills. Draw these six meanings in reading order: a house marking the home page; a USB key with a check for setting up digital signatures; a folded sheet with a circular history arrow for past versions; a broken-outline sheet with a returning arrow for recovering an unsaved document; two offset sheets with an arrow turning over an edge for two-sided printing; a diskette with a small pencil for saving a new copy. Leave open space around each, no labels.
setupusbtoken.round_2: Extended the metal plug and token body to the height of the frame. Squared the shoulders, separated the two contacts and set both check strokes at 45 degrees.
setupusbtoken.round_3: Reduced the metal fill to the top of the plug. Set two narrow contact slots above an open, square-shouldered body and retained the 45-degree check.
setupusbtoken.round_4: The metal accent remains on the plug behind its two contact slots, as in the approved drawing.

previousversions.meaning: View previous versions of this document.
previousversions.concept: Rough concept sheet, six separate small drawings on white, two rows of three. Flat outline icon, rounded strokes, 24 px grid, soft pastel fills. Draw these six meanings in reading order: a house marking the home page; a USB key with a check for setting up digital signatures; a folded sheet with a circular history arrow for past versions; a broken-outline sheet with a returning arrow for recovering an unsaved document; two offset sheets with an arrow turning over an edge for two-sided printing; a diskette with a small pencil for saving a new copy. Leave open space around each, no labels.
previousversions.round_2: Extended the folded page and replaced the circular history sweep with a square clock, a returning corner arrow and right-angle hands.
previousversions.round_3: Restored the round clock beside the folded page. Centred the face on a pixel centre, with a 4-unit radius on the native master and 6 on the larger master. Short, right-angle hands leave the face open.
previousversions.round_4: The page fold retains the approved slate tint beside the round clock.

unsaveddocuments.meaning: Recover a document closed without saving.
unsaveddocuments.concept: Rough concept sheet, six separate small drawings on white, two rows of three. Flat outline icon, rounded strokes, 24 px grid, soft pastel fills. Draw these six meanings in reading order: a house marking the home page; a USB key with a check for setting up digital signatures; a folded sheet with a circular history arrow for past versions; a broken-outline sheet with a returning arrow for recovering an unsaved document; two offset sheets with an arrow turning over an edge for two-sided printing; a diskette with a small pencil for saving a new copy. Leave open space around each, no labels.
unsaveddocuments.round_2: Extended the interrupted page outline, reduced the breaks and squared the shaft of the left-facing restore arrow. Kept the folded corner in slate.
unsaveddocuments.round_3: Reduced ink around the fold and return arrow. The page keeps its interrupted outside edge and the native arrowhead uses whole-pixel steps.
unsaveddocuments.round_4: The interrupted page retains its compact slate corner fold above the return arrow.

toggleduplex.meaning: Print on both sides of each sheet.
toggleduplex.concept: Rough concept sheet, six separate small drawings on white, two rows of three. Flat outline icon, rounded strokes, 24 px grid, soft pastel fills. Draw these six meanings in reading order: a house marking the home page; a USB key with a check for setting up digital signatures; a folded sheet with a circular history arrow for past versions; a broken-outline sheet with a returning arrow for recovering an unsaved document; two offset sheets with an arrow turning over an edge for two-sided printing; a diskette with a small pencil for saving a new copy. Leave open space around each, no labels.
toggleduplex.round_2: Separated the two offset sheets and squared the upward turn of the duplex arrow. Shortened the rear sheet to balance the added ink.
toggleduplex.round_3: Reduced the back sheet to its visible folded-over area and a short ink corner. The front sheet has a continuous bottom edge that returns upward into the arrow.
toggleduplex.round_4: The rear sheet carries the original slate tint along its outline and in a narrow strip inside its top edge. Both sheets stay open around the arrow that curls back over the front sheet.

saveas.meaning: Save this document under a new name.
saveas.concept: Rough concept sheet, six separate small drawings on white, two rows of three. Flat outline icon, rounded strokes, 24 px grid, soft pastel fills. Draw these six meanings in reading order: a house marking the home page; a USB key with a check for setting up digital signatures; a folded sheet with a circular history arrow for past versions; a broken-outline sheet with a returning arrow for recovering an unsaved document; two offset sheets with an arrow turning over an edge for two-sided printing; a diskette with a small pencil for saving a new copy. Leave open space around each, no labels.
saveas.round_2: Extended the diskette and cut the edges of the diagonal gold pencil on the pixel grid. Kept a distinct open nib and aligned the shutter and label.
saveas.round_3: Cleared the disk body around the blue shutter and open label. A narrow metal rim completes the far corner behind the gold pencil, which keeps a dark leading edge and exposed nib.
saveas.round_4: Used the HST save diskette as the model for a square blue shell with a clipped corner, slotted metal shutter and inset paper label. A short gold pencil overlaps the lower right corner.

sidebar-property.meaning: Open the Properties deck in the sidebar.
sidebar-property.concept: Rough concept sheet, three separate little drawings in one row. Flat outline icon, rounded strokes, 24 px grid, soft pastel fills. Draw adjustable slider controls for properties, a letter A with little color swatches for styles, and a compass with a pointed needle for navigation. Equal weight with ample space on white, no captions.
sidebar-property.round_2: Extended the three tracks and replaced the round knobs with small rounded-square teal sliders at staggered positions.
sidebar-property.round_3: Reduced the three slider handles to small square outlines with short teal indicators. The long tracks meet each handle at its sides.
sidebar-property.round_4: Three staggered knobs have teal centres bounded by ink. Each native knob has a 3 × 3 px teal interior. The 24-unit master uses 5-unit rounded squares and ends each track at the sides of its knob.

sidebar-style.meaning: Open the Styles deck in the sidebar.
sidebar-style.concept: Rough concept sheet, three separate little drawings in one row. Flat outline icon, rounded strokes, 24 px grid, soft pastel fills. Draw adjustable slider controls for properties, a letter A with little color swatches for styles, and a compass with a pointed needle for navigation. Equal weight with ample space on white, no captions.
sidebar-style.round_2: Opened up the A with a crossbar, short feet and 45-degree diagonals. Extended the three swatches across a single framed strip.
sidebar-style.round_3: Removed the feet from the A and narrowed the three-colour swatch strip beneath its crossbar.
sidebar-style.round_4: A single five-unit-high frame below the A holds three adjoining, integer-edged swatches in the original violet, coral and gold.

sidebar-navigator.meaning: Open the Navigator deck in the sidebar.
sidebar-navigator.concept: Rough concept sheet, three separate little drawings in one row. Flat outline icon, rounded strokes, 24 px grid, soft pastel fills. Draw adjustable slider controls for properties, a letter A with little color swatches for styles, and a compass with a pointed needle for navigation. Equal weight with ample space on white, no captions.
sidebar-navigator.round_2: Replaced the circular compass case with a rounded square. Set the needle upright and kept its north facet coral.
sidebar-navigator.round_3: Restored a circular compass case centred at (11.5, 11.5) with radius 9. The north needle has 45-degree tips, straight flanks and a small coral facet.
sidebar-navigator.round_4: The round case encloses a diagonal diamond with an open southwest half and a dark pivot. The broader coral northeast face on the 24-unit grid keeps the facet visible after snapping. The native 16 px drawing retains its original coral face.

signature-status.meaning: Show that the document has been digitally signed.
signature-status.concept: Rough concept sheet for the small status mark meaning a document has been digitally signed. Flat outline icon, rounded strokes, 24 px grid, soft pastel fills. Explore a checked seal and a pen nib meeting a signature line, side by side, with clear open space, on white. No labels.
signature-status.round_2: Extended the seal and notched ribbon to the full height. Used a faceted outline and 45-degree check with the teal fill tucked under the seal.
signature-status.round_3: Narrowed the native checked seal and ribbon. On the larger seal a thin rim, short engraved marks and narrow ribbon folds keep the check distinct.
signature-status.round_4: The single check sits inside a round seal above two splayed, fork-cut green ribbon tails. Both masters draw the teal fill on integer vertices. The short outside folds leave the colour visible at 16 px.

sidebar-menu.concept: Three evenly spaced bars carry a short teal index on the middle row.

deck-close.concept: Two diagonals meet in a compact cross. A coral tip picks out the rising arm.

deck-grip.concept: Four dots make a vertical grip with a teal foot on its lowest dot.

selection-standard.meaning: Select one continuous run of text.
selection-standard.concept: A blue highlight encloses a short text run and ends beside an I-beam caret.

selection-extending.concept: A right-facing arrow continues along the baseline beyond a blue text run.

selection-adding.meaning: Add a separate text run to the selection.
selection-adding.concept: A plus sits in the space between two independently highlighted runs of text.

selection-block.meaning: Select a rectangular block of text.
selection-block.concept: The blue rectangle covers the same span in two text rows. The unselected words extend past opposite edges.

position.concept: A blue crosshair sits above two coordinate axes. Short guides lead the eye to the corresponding tick on each axis.

size.meaning: Show the dimensions of the current object.
size.concept: A teal rectangle sits over a double-ended dimension line aligned with its sides.

viewlayout-single.concept: One upright page has a short running head in ink and a slate accent below it.

viewlayout-single-active.meaning: Indicate that single-page view is active.
viewlayout-single-active.concept: The single-page outline becomes a solid leaf with a blue index descending from its top edge.

viewlayout-auto.concept: Two separate upright pages have matching running heads and a narrow slate gutter.

viewlayout-auto-active.meaning: Indicate that automatic multi-page view is active.
viewlayout-auto-active.concept: The two upright pages keep their gutter and become solid leaves, each marked with a blue index.

viewlayout-book.concept: Two facing leaves meet at a recessed central spine. A running head on each leaf makes the spread readable at small sizes.

viewlayout-book-active.meaning: Indicate that facing-page book view is active.
viewlayout-book-active.concept: The joined spread becomes solid ink with a blue ribbon along the same recessed spine.

zoom-out.concept: A compact minus has a short blue highlight near its left end.

zoom-in.concept: A small blue hub marks the crossing of the horizontal and vertical arms.

zoom-thumb.meaning: Drag the zoom slider to set the zoom level.
zoom-thumb.concept: A narrow upright handle has rounded shoulders and a blue inset. The two larger masters have a central grip rib.

zoom-page.meaning: Fit the whole page in the view.
zoom-page.concept: Four corner brackets enclose a blue sheet. Its ink-coloured fold identifies the page at the smallest size.

about.concept: A lowercase i sits in a round information sign. The blue dot is separate from the upright stem, with a single rim at 16 px.

recent-pin.meaning: Pin a document to the recent list.
recent-pin.concept: A narrow pin descends from a flared shoulder. A short blue cap catches the eye above the shaft.

sidebar-inspector.meaning: Inspect the properties of the current selection.
sidebar-inspector.concept: A round blue lens sits beside four rows, with a short diagonal handle clear of the list.

sidebar-a11y.concept: An open-armed figure stands inside a circular sign. A teal check occupies its lower right corner.

sidebar-gallery.concept: One mountain rises from the lower rail of a landscape frame. A gold sun occupies the open sky to its right.

sidebar-template.concept: A landscape slide contains a title rule above a blue layout block and a short second column.

sidebar-animation.concept: Five staggered speed lines trail a violet disc bearing a play triangle.

sidebar-transition.concept: A second slide sits in front of the first. A blue arrow points across the front slide.

sidebar-functions.concept: A hooked f with a crossbar precedes a lower-set x on a blue field.

sidebar-trackchanges.meaning: Open the deck for managing tracked changes.
sidebar-trackchanges.concept: A coral revision bar groups two lines of text. A pencil with a dark tip occupies the open corner of the sheet.

sidebar-design.concept: A folded sheet carries a violet swatch with a short caption beneath it.

sidebar-elements.concept: An angular capital sigma has a gold upper terminal and an upturned lower foot.

signature-broken.concept: An exclamation mark within a coral rim replaces the check on the approved round seal above the same fork-cut teal ribbons.

signature-notvalidated.meaning: Indicate that the signature certificate has not been validated.
signature-notvalidated.concept: A question mark within a gold rim replaces the check on the approved seal. The fork-cut teal ribbons identify the family.

doc-modified-no.meaning: Indicate that the document has no unsaved changes.
doc-modified-no.concept: An empty sheet with a metal-tinted fold establishes the page silhouette shared by the three save states.

doc-modified-yes.meaning: Indicate that the document has unsaved changes.
doc-modified-yes.concept: A coral dot inside the lower half of the common folded page marks a pending change.

doc-modified-feedback.meaning: Indicate that document changes are being saved.
doc-modified-feedback.concept: A small blue arrow moves across the lower half of the common folded page.

a11y-check-ok.meaning: Indicate that the accessibility check found no issues.
a11y-check-ok.concept: A teal check sits at the right of an open-armed figure. The figure keeps the same pose in both check states.

a11y-check-issues.meaning: Indicate that the accessibility check found issues.
a11y-check-issues.concept: A coral exclamation badge sits at the right of the same open-armed figure.
